1.title: Compliance Management with Microsoft Purview
1.text: Welcome to Module twelve: Compliance Management with Microsoft Purview. It covers the exam area Capabilities of Microsoft compliance solutions. Each part of this module comes from the study notes of the same name, so you can read the notes after you watch.

1.title: What You Will Learn
1.text: By the end of this module you will be able to do four things. Describe the Microsoft Purview portal. Describe Microsoft Purview Compliance Manager. Describe the compliance score. Practice with exam-style questions and a recall check.

1.title: Where This Fits in the Exam
1.text: Here is where this module sits in the exam. Exam area: Capabilities of Microsoft compliance solutions (twenty to twenty-five percent). Exam format: forty-five minutes; a score of seven hundred on a scale of one to one thousand passes. Validated against: the official S C nine hundred study guide, skills measured as of October twenty-one, two thousand twenty-six.

1.title: Microsoft Purview
1.text: Microsoft Purview. Microsoft Purview is a family of data governance, risk and compliance solutions. It helps you know your data, protect it, and meet regulations. Data security. Information Protection, D L P, Insider Risk Management. Data governance. Data Map, Unified Catalog, data classification. Risk and compliance. Compliance Manager, e discovery, Audit, Communication Compliance.

1.title: Microsoft Purview, continued
1.text: Microsoft Purview. The figure shows this: Microsoft Purview: data security, data governance and risk and compliance solutions.

1.title: The Microsoft Purview portal
1.text: The Microsoft Purview portal. The Microsoft Purview portal (purview.microsoft.com) is the single place to manage these solutions: Compliance Manager, Data Loss Prevention, Information Protection, e discovery, Audit, Insider Risk Management, data lifecycle management and more. Older Microsoft three sixty-five compliance center and Microsoft Purview compliance portal names are earlier versions. Access to features depends on licensing and role groups (for example Compliance Administrator). Exam tip: Purview portal equals where compliance and data protection solutions live. Defender portal equals threat protection. Know which portal does which. Exam tip: Purview portal equals compliance and data solutions. Compliance Manager equals assess controls against regulations and get improvement actions.

1.title: Compliance Manager
1.text: Compliance Manager. Microsoft Purview Compliance Manager helps you understand and improve your compliance posture by assessing controls against regulations and standards and giving improvement actions. Assessment. An evaluation of your controls against a regulation or standard (G D P R, I S O twenty-seven thousand one, nist, hip ah, and others). Template. Starting point for an assessment. Control. A requirement of the regulation. Improvement action. A recommended step to meet a control. Solution. The product feature that implements the action. Microsoft actions. Controls Microsoft is responsible for. Your actions. Controls you are responsible for (customer-managed). Shared actions. Responsibility split.

1.title: Compliance Manager, continued
1.text: Compliance Manager. The figure shows this: Compliance Manager: assessments contain controls, which have improvement actions that raise the compliance score.

1.title: Compliance Manager, continued
1.text: Compliance Manager. Compliance Manager supports the shared responsibility idea: some actions are Microsoft's, some yours.

1.title: Compliance score
1.text: Compliance score. The compliance score is a percentage that measures progress toward completing recommended improvement actions. It shows your overall posture and per-assessment scores. Points. Each action has points; higher-risk actions carry more. Microsoft-managed actions. Add to the score automatically. Your actions. You implement and test them to earn points. Meaning. It is a measure of progress, not proof of compliance or a certification. Exam tip: Compliance score (Purview) is not the same as secure score (Defender for Cloud and Microsoft three sixty-five). Compliance score equals regulatory improvement actions. A high score does not guarantee legal compliance.

1.title: Practice Question 1
1.text: Question one. Fabrikam Outdoors wants to assess its controls against G D P R and get recommended improvement actions. Which tool fits? The four options are on the screen. The answer is A: Microsoft Purview Compliance Manager. Compliance Manager assesses controls against regulations and recommends actions.

1.title: Practice Question 2
1.text: Question two. What does the compliance score measure? The four options are on the screen. The answer is D: Progress toward completing recommended improvement actions. It measures progress on improvement actions.

1.title: Practice Question 3
1.text: Question three. Which portal gives access to Compliance Manager, D L P and e discovery? The four options are on the screen. The answer is B: Microsoft Purview portal. The Purview portal hosts compliance and data protection solutions.

1.title: Practice Question 4
1.text: Question four. In Compliance Manager, who performs a "Microsoft action"? The four options are on the screen. The answer is B: Microsoft. Microsoft actions are controls that Microsoft is responsible for.

1.title: Practice Question 5
1.text: Question five. A high compliance score means what? The four options are on the screen. The answer is B: Progress toward actions, but not proof of legal compliance. The score shows progress and is not a guarantee of compliance.

1.title: Practice Question 6
1.text: Question six. What is an improvement action? The four options are on the screen. The answer is B: A recommended step to meet a control. Improvement actions help satisfy controls.

1.title: Recall Check 1
1.text: Recall check one. Say each answer out loud before you listen to mine. Question one. What is Microsoft Purview? Answer: A family of data governance, risk and compliance solutions. Question two. What is an assessment? Answer: An evaluation of your controls against a regulation or standard. Question three. What does the compliance score show? Answer: Progress on recommended improvement actions.

1.title: Recall Check 2
1.text: Recall check two. Say each answer out loud before you listen to mine. Question four. What are the three action owners? Answer: Microsoft, you and shared. Question five. Which portal hosts Purview solutions? Answer: The Microsoft Purview portal. Question six. Is the compliance score proof of compliance? Answer: No, it measures progress only.

1.title: Module Recap
1.text: Here is the recap. Purview: data security, governance, risk and compliance solutions. Portal: purview.microsoft.com; hosts Compliance Manager, D L P, e discovery, Audit, and more. Compliance Manager: assessments, templates, controls, improvement actions; Microsoft, your and shared actions. Compliance score: percent progress on actions; not proof of compliance. In the next module, we continue the course.
